lines.ruling: Ruling: refusal located elsewhere; restatement accepted. The omitted lines are refused on the asset: line 15 (property elected out of MACRS) and line 16 (other depreciation, including ACRS) through asset.screen ('by a method other than the MACRS percentage tables') and the years placed in service the tool offers (2005 to 2025); lines 19g to 19j (25-year, residential rental, nonresidential real property) through asset.screen ('real property ... or land') and the recovery-class lookup (macrs_period has only 3- to 20-year periods and 'outside'); line 20 (ADS) through asset.screen ('you depreciate it under ADS'), each refusing asset.cost (asset.screened). Vehicles are listed property on line 21. With those refused the total is the lines listed.

Ruling: refusal located elsewhere; restatement accepted. Listed property used 50% or less (line 27) is refused on the asset (asset.basis refuses on asset.listed_low, 'Listed property used 50% or less in a qualified business use (Form 4562 line 27)') and on an owned vehicle depreciated by actual expenses (scveh.placed refuses on scveh.low_use); a leased vehicle or one on the standard mileage rate has no column (h) depreciation. Checked: classm.asset.1 with item_1 listed at 40% gives sc.f26h refused on listed_low, and car_1 owned at under 50% gives it refused on low_use. So every entry the helper adds belongs on line 26.
